# Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics

Production diagnostics for .NET MAUI: crash, ANR/freeze, unhandled exceptions, and pre-crash breadcrumbs with device and session context.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-diagnostics
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics

Registration: `UseMauiDiagnostics` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I capture MAUI crashes and ANRs?
- What happened before the crash (breadcrumbs)?
- Lightweight crash reporter without a SaaS

## Do not use when

- The team already standardized on Sentry, Crashlytics, or App Center Crashes
- You only need environment health — use Plugin.Maui.AppHealth
